title: I. SURVEY OF CRIME I.P.C. Crime 9,52,581 cognizable crimes under the Indian Penal Code were reported in India during 1971 showing a very marginal decrease of 0.3% over 1970. This figure includes crimes committed by juveniles. The trend of crime during the sixties shows a rise till the year 1967, except for marginal decreases in 1963 and 1965. There was a decrease from 1967 to 1969. During 1970 there had been a very sharp increase while during 1971 there was again a marginal decrease.
